Passed check per call site: dimension (_check_dimensions), variable (_check_variables/_check_variable including the PASSED/DIFFERENT dtype+dims findings), global_attribute (_check_global_attributes), attribute (_check_variables_attributes/_check_variable_attributes/_check_required_attributes/_check_valid_min_max/_check_fill_value). Design choice: check has NO default on Finding (kw_only field via dataclasses.field(kw_only=True)) since _Reporter.finding()/partition() are the only construction sites and can supply it every time -- an omission now raises TypeError at construction rather than silently defaulting. results_file DOES default on both Finding and _Reporter, since test_rules_validation.py constructs _Reporter positionally with exactly 3 args (module_name, filepath, validation) and must not be edited. Fixed the dimension-mismatch message in _check_variable to print result.dims (names) on both sides instead of result.shape (sizes) -- it now reads '(contract dims: [...]) and (result dims: (...))'. Added tests in tests/test_validation.py (results_file differs across two files while filepath stays constant; dimension vs variable findings for component 'nt' differ in check; message format) and a new tests/test_report.py (check required, results_file default, hashability preserved). 136 existing tests unchanged and passing; 143 total pass; ruff clean. Commit 84ba736 on worktree branch (to be cherry-picked onto issue-10-findings-report).

Implemented Report aggregation in src/cit/report.py: added FindingStatus.REPORT (sorts last in _SEVERITY -- it's outside the pass/fail/warn ladder, never affects exit_code, and must never outrank a real finding when a group is ranked by worst severity); wired _SEVERITY into a shared _sort_key(severity, module, component, check, message, filepath) used by both grouped_by and deduplicated, removing the TODO and dead commented sort line. Report.deduplicated() -> list[DedupedFinding] where DedupedFinding(finding, count, files) keys on every Finding field except results_file (via dataclasses.replace(finding, results_file='')), count is total raw occurrences, files is the sorted distinct results_file set (so 9.3 can render 'x19 files' or name the one file). Report.grouped_by(key: Callable[[Finding], str]) -> dict[str, list[Finding]] is fully axis-agnostic per the 9.3 component-first amendment -- no severity-sectioned shape baked in -- with alphabetical key order and each group's findings in _sort_key order for determinism. Report.exit_code is a property: 1 iff any finding.status is FAIL else 0; REPORT is excluded by construction since only FAIL is checked. Report does NOT re-escalate under --strict (comment explains validation._status already promotes at emit time; records the measured 171 WARN->FAIL / 92-untouched asymmetry). Added Report.findings property returning the raw undeduplicated list so 9.4's CSV export can still reach every occurrence -- self._findings itself is never discarded or replaced. Extended tests/test_report.py (did not replace it) with 10 new tests: severity ordering via grouped_by, dedup collapsing on results_file-only difference (2 files), dedup staying separate on differing message and on shared-component/differing-check ('nt' case), exit_code for FAIL/WARN-only/empty/REPORT-only(even conceptually under strict) runs, grouped_by determinism under reversed insertion order, and Report.findings round-tripping every raw occurrence. Updated the report.py module docstring's Planned block to mark Report as landed and re-scope the remaining P1-9 work (9.3 rendering, 9.4 CSV, 9.5 CLI). 143->153 tests pass, ruff check clean, no TODOs left. Commit 51bcf6c on branch worktree-agent-abeb336f57ec32acf (cherry-picked pj2.1's 1f28621 first to get the correct starting point, since this worktree's branch had not yet received it).

Implemented Report.__str__: banner (cit + per-module version/branch/commit via importlib.metadata and Contract), legend, load-bearing counts line, and component-first grouping (module -> filepath template -> component, components ranked by worst severity then name, findings within a component ordered FAIL->WARN->PASS). show_passed lives on Report.__init__ (not __str__, which the locked API requires to take no args) and defaults to hiding all-PASSED components while always showing every finding for a component that has at least one non-PASSED entry (the momma 'nt' case). contracts param is dict[str, Contract] (reuses Orchestrate.contracts directly), optional with degraded-banner fallback. orchestrate.py: run() now passes its (subset-filtered) contracts into Report, forwards show_passed, and the personal-path __main__ block is deleted. Follow-up design change (user-approved): deduplicated is now a public functools.cached_property returning tuple[DedupedFinding, ...] instead of a method backed by a private _deduped. Immutability (frozen DedupedFinding + tuple files) replaces the per-call defensive copy that a cached_property cannot provide. __init__ still copies self._findings.
